samples.question: A ball enters at the black dot on top and runs down the wiring: at every black wedge it goes off to the side the wedge points, meets the next wedge below, and finally drops into one of the colored cups. The square at the top left shows a goal color. Turning a wedge means making it point the opposite way and changing nothing else. Exactly one of the four ringed wedges can be turned so that the ball ends in a cup of the goal color. Which ring is it? Answer blue, crimson, green, or violet.
